correctness.rationale: The published variational formula is reduced by reflection to decreasing affine-power weights; a uniform \(2/s\) tail bound keeps all maximizing parameters in a fixed compact interval. The explicit exponential-polynomial derivative has a single sign change: negative Taylor coefficients through degree thirteen and strictly positive coefficients thereafter via a verified induction. This gives a unique nondegenerate limiting maximizer. A uniform \(C^2\) expansion of (1-st/m)^m yields \(D_n\)=\(D_\infty\)-C/(n-2)+\(O((n-2)^{-2})\) and eventual profile uniqueness. An exact-rational standalone checker verifies coefficient identities, critical-root sign bounds, and \(C>0\).
